title: Agent-ValueBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Agent Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating agent trajectories in simulated executable environments that force trade-offs between competing moral principles (e.g., using Moral Foundations Theory to test Care vs. Authority) via a rubric-based LLM-as-Judge.

Assessing agent behaviors in value-conflict tasks mapped to cross-cultural psychological frameworks (e.g., Hofstede's VSM13, Schwartz Values) to determine cultural value prioritizations like Individualism vs. Collectivism.
Measuring agent decision-making against established psychological personality and cognitive inventories (e.g., HEXACO, Big Five, Need for Cognitive Closure) through trajectory-level adjudication.
